responsibility: GCC driver specs fragment that teaches the generic driver how to compile Modula-2 source and preprocessed Modula-2 source. It defines the @modula-2 and @modula-2-cpp-output language handlers, specifies when cc1gm2 should invoke the C preprocessor wrapper options, and controls the handoff to assembly output, so this file is the declarative driver-spec companion to the imperative argument rewriting in gm2spec.cc.
